spec_evidence.checked: Cached snapshots, token-level: information_link 3->2 (survivor is a static example inside error_503, not a property; new error schemas are {name,message,details,debug_id,links}). Wallet profile fields: birth_date 1->0, tax_info 3->0, alternate_full_name 1->0, address_details 2->0, admin_area_4 1->0; new paypal_wallet_response/venmo_response resolved name props = {given_name,surname} (old name schema had 7 props), address keeps the six core portable fields. apple_pay card props 10->5 (id/number/expiry/security_code/card_type dropped; billing_address/brand/last_digits/name/type survive). payment_source.bank: ach_debit token 7->0, schemas ach_debit_response/bank_response deleted, no bank schema in new spec. ordinal token 4->0, schema deleted. token_id_request.type: old enum ["BILLING_AGREEMENT"], new spec documents SETUP_TOKEN only (x-enumDescriptions). Card request: old card schema 10 props (id/last_digits/card_type/type present) -> new definitions-payment_source.card request 7 props; billing_address props 10->6 (address_line_3/admin_area_3/admin_area_4/address_details dropped).

fix.migration_guide: The information_link field was removed from Payment Method Tokens v3 error bodies (POST /v3/vault/setup-tokens; spec token verified, no successor property — error bodies are now {name, message, details, debug_id, links}). Delete reads of information_link; use the links array (HATEOAS) or debug_id for support correlation instead.
